name: Benchmarking histopathology foundation models in a multi-center dataset for skin cancer subtyping
description: This benchmark evaluates histopathology foundation models as patch-level feature extractors for skin cancer subtyping in a multi-center multiple-instance learning setting, focusing on real-world generalization across institutions and slide variability.
evaluation_method: Multi-class classification performance in a MIL pipeline, typically reported with balanced accuracy, macro F1, AUROC, or related per-class and aggregate classification metrics.
notes: Designed to test foundation models under multi-center domain shift and challenging histopathology variability. The relevant comparison unit is often the downstream MIL classifier rather than the FM alone.
